{{Quote|The Mirr is for the Mystics. Only they can see.|Tolec-Da|<ref name="A Potential Problem" />}}
The '''Mirr''' was a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that came to reside on the planet [[Voss]], where it was embraced by the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] people. Believed by the [[Voss Mystics]] to have allowed them to hold clearer visions, the relic became an item of local legend.<ref name="A Potential Problem" />

==History==
In the past, it resided in a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] altar on Voss where it remained until the years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At the time, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sallius Wen]] was dispatched to aid the Voss who desired the recovery of the relic with [[Tolec-Da]] part of the recovery effort. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Wen came to realize that the Mirr was no Voss artifact but rather had a connection to the Sith and decided not to retrieve it in fears of it corrupting the Mystics.<ref name="A Potential Problem" />

A spacer aligned with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was tasked with a mission to retrieve the relic where they were privately informed by Wen that the artifact needed to remain lost.<ref name="A Potential Problem" />
